newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Guangdong ITIC closes US$70 mln FRN issue.
newsitem.headline: China's Guangdong ITIC closes US$70 mln FRN issue.

text.p: Guangdong International Trust and Investment Corp (GITIC) Hong Kong branch has closed a US$70 million private placement floating rate note issue, said arranger Seoulbank.
The facility has a three-year maturity and pays a margin of 100 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Seoulbank, Commercial Bank of Korea, Korea First Bank, Merrill Lynch Far East, Shinhan Bank and Sumitomo Finance (Asia) are arrangers and lead managers.
Dongwha Bank and SBC Warburg are managers.
GITIC is wholly owned and directly controlled by the Guangdong provincial government.

It has been approved by the government to engage in financial services and businesses involving foreign currencies since 1983 and was one of the original "10 windows" designated by the People's Bank of China to raise foreign debt during the early 1990s.
